## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: special driving conditions (night, weather, emergencies, floods, work zones and stopped emergency vehicles)
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The night-crash statistic covers a past five-year window and is taught only as a historical figure, not a current rate [A01].
The studded-tire dates are stated exactly as printed; no county or local exception is asserted [A02].
The shoulder-use rule cites a bill of the 2023 Nevada Legislature and an effective date; the bill was not consulted and only the handbook's summary is taught [A06].
Statute numbers are kept only as short references; no statute text is copied.

corpus_stability.reason: The Nevada Driver's Handbook carries one edition line on its cover (DMV 700 March 2024) and one copyright year on its title page, with a short key-changes list; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year. The edition is about two and a half years old at intake, so currency is held as freshness debt in part A.
